turns.replyTail:
ntact.

If you’ve chosen a custom or personalised piece, you can exchange it for store credit within 30 days of delivery (refunds aren’t available for personalised items). Only one exchange per original order is allowed.

Earrings can only be returned once per customer per year, and just a heads-up, gift packaging, greeting cards, e-gift cards, and Advent Calendars are non-returnable.

If you ever need to start a return, just let me know and I’ll help you through it! 🧡
